key_insight: ASALT enables lateral transfer in multi-agent reinforcement learning by aligning mismatched target and source state/observation spaces into a shared embedding space.
engineering_relevance: This makes cross-domain policy reuse more practical for MARL systems where environments differ in state dimensionality, improving transfer without requiring identical input spaces.
method: Uses observation-level adapters to map target observations into a shared latent space.
Uses state-level adapters to align global states for both actors and critics.
Supports strategy transfer while reducing negative transfer across heterogeneous domains.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on standard benchmark environments show ASALT improves sample efficiency and global return in cooperative settings relative to baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the degree of source-target mismatch, so adapter design and alignment quality may become a limiting factor in highly heterogeneous transfers.
paper_title: ASALT: Adaptive State Alignment for Lateral Transfer in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
